steps.title: The space inside the shell
actions: File > New > Standard (mm).ipt and save it as float_foam.ipt.
Derive the cavity of float_hull.ipt: Manage tab > Derive, pick the inside of the shell. (Or revolve the inside profile: 488 diameter, 1008 high, round the well of diameter 302.)
steps.note: The foam is poured in liquid through a filling hole and expands to fill the shell.

steps.title: Tie rod holes
actions: Hole: diameter 16 Through All at radius 195, Circular Pattern of 3. Save.
